sources.quote: 7 Andromedae, also named Honores, is a single, yellow-white hued star in the northern constellation of Andromeda.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.8 solar radii and 1.57 solar masses (FLAME) and 7,229 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
